> 第19章 借三轮车（第1页）
“傻大春啊，这么早啊，有事吗？”杏婶婶问道。
“我想借用一下你家的三轮车。”柳大春直接说道。
杏婶一听是借三轮车，便站了起来，问道：“想借三轮车啊？”
杏婶打量着柳大春，是个年轻的结实的傻男人，便笑着说道：“婶婶不白借的。”
“那我可以租。婶婶你看，多少钱合适？”柳大春认真问道。
“那你就见外了。”杏婶婶放下了碗，任娃坐在那里折腾着，走了过来，打量着傻大春，像是在物色一个优美的工具一样，便说道：“婶婶想要其他东西。”
“啊？”柳大春以为自己听错了，当即叫了出来。
这实在是柳大春听过的最荒唐的要求了。
“怎么了？你嫌弃婶婶呢？婶婶可干净着呢。”杏婶有点小脾气的说道。
杏婶想着，柳大春是个傻子，和他说什么估计也不懂是什么意思，干脆忽悠忽悠一下这个傻子，兴许能骗他让自己快乐一下。
柳大春急忙摆摆手，解释不是那个意思，心里却想着，这婶婶怎么提这种奇怪的要求？
就算自己是个傻子，也不能如此贱吧？
“那你是嫌弃婶婶年纪大了？？”杏婶又问道。
“不是，不是。”柳大春也不知道该怎么解释了，只是这要求也太奇葩了一点呢。
杏婶白了傻大春一眼，笑着说道：“婶婶给你占便宜呢，还不要？如果嘴巴你嫌弃的话，那婶婶其他给你。”
“啊？真的假的啊？婶婶。”柳大春有点不好意思了，这个便宜不错，这哪里是自己便宜她，这分明就是婶婶便宜了自己啊！！
要是这样都可以，那我天天来借三轮车了。
柳大春想着，这个杏婶婶也太开放了吧，不然也不会如此了。

“当然是真的啊，三轮车借不？”杏婶很严肃地问道。
“借，借。只是借三轮车什么价格啊？婶。”柳大春尴尬问道。
“看你一脸不情感的样子，婶婶给你打个折，就五次吧，怎么样？”杏婶婶讨价还价地说道。
柳大春也是第一次见这样讨价还价的。
“那行吧。”柳大春还表现得勉为其难，心里倒是乐开了花。
“那你跟婶婶进屋，不能在外面，被人看见了，还以为婶婶欺负你这个傻子呢。呵呵。”杏婶婶也是高兴。
大清早的逮到一个傻男人，敢情也是很不错的。
这个傻子年轻结实，比村里的那些老头子强多了。
婶婶把孙子也抱了进去，放到了床上，让他自己玩会，然后把柳大春拉进了内屋，关了门窗，这样一来，内屋就黑了下来。
柳大春也是大方进屋，既然要借三轮车，这个钱自然是要付的，不能赖账的。

> Chapter 19 Borrowing a Tricycle (Page 1)
"Silly Dachun, it's so early, is there anything wrong?" Aunt Xing asked.
"I would like to borrow your tricycle." Liu Dachun said directly.
When Aunt Xing heard that she was borrowing a tricycle, she stood up and asked, "Want to borrow a tricycle?"
Aunt Xing looked at Liu Dachun, who was a young, strong and silly man, and said with a smile: "Auntie didn't borrow it for free."
"Then I can rent it. Auntie, how much is appropriate?" Liu Dachun asked seriously.
"Then you're out of sight." Aunt Xing put down the bowl, and Ren Wa sat there tossing around. Then she came over, looked at Silly Dachun, as if she was looking for a beautiful tool, and said, "Aunt Xing wants something else."
"Ah?" Liu Dachun thought he heard wrongly and immediately shouted out.
This is really the most ridiculous request Liu Dachun has ever heard.
"What's wrong? Do you dislike Auntie? Auntie is very clean." Aunt Xing said with a little temper.
Aunt Xing thought, Liu Dachun was a fool, and she probably didn't understand what he meant by anything she said to him, so she might as well trick this fool, maybe she could trick him into making herself happy.
Liu Dachun waved his hands hurriedly, explaining that he didn't mean that, but he was thinking in his heart, why did this aunt make such a strange request?
Even if you are a fool, you can't be so mean, right?
"Then you dislike Auntie for being too old?" Auntie Xing asked again.
"No, no." Liu Dachun didn't know how to explain it, but this request was a little too weird.
Aunt Xing rolled her eyes at Silly Dachun and said with a smile: "Auntie is giving you an advantage, why don't you want it? If you dislike the mouth, then Auntie will give you the rest."
"Ah? Is it true? Auntie." Liu Dachun was a little embarrassed. This was a good bargain. How could he be taking advantage of her? It was clearly his aunt who was taking advantage of him! !
If this were all possible, I would come here to borrow a tricycle every day.
Liu Dachun thought, this Aunt Xing was too open-minded, otherwise she wouldn't be like this.
"Of course it's true. Can I borrow a tricycle?" Aunt Xing asked seriously.
"Borrow, borrow. What's the price for just borrowing a tricycle? Auntie." Liu Dachun asked awkwardly.
"Looking at your emotionless look, Auntie will give you a discount, just five times. How about that?" Auntie Xing said in a bargaining manner.
It was also the first time for Liu Dachun to see such bargaining.
"That's okay." Liu Dachun still acted reluctantly, but he was actually happy in his heart.
"Then you and Auntie go into the house. You can't stay outside. If someone sees you, you will think that Auntie is bullying you, a fool. Haha." Aunt Xing was also happy.
Caught a stupid man early in the morning, it is also very good to be affectionate.
This fool is young and strong, much better than the old men in the village.
The aunt took her grandson in and put him on the bed, letting him play for a while. Then she pulled Liu Dachun into the inner room and closed the doors and windows. As a result, the inner room became dark.
Liu Dachun also entered the house generously. Since he wanted to borrow a tricycle, he had to pay the money and could not default on it.
